title: Ask HN: Why is the HN crowd so anti-AI?
summary: A Hacker News user questions why the HN community appears so anti-AI, citing frequent posts criticizing AI for writing bad code, introducing bugs, and creating technical debt. The poster argues that code is merely a means to an end and that users only care whether the product works, not how it was created.
problem_solved: Explores community sentiment and skepticism toward AI-assisted software development on Hacker News
why_valuable: Raises important questions about the tension between AI tool adoption and traditional software engineering quality standards
